name: Callirius

attributes.attribute: god of the forest and the wild

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Callirius is a god of ancient Britain. His temple stood near Colchester. The Romans set him beside Silvanus. Silvanus ruled the wild. People also name Callirius the spirit of the land.

okr.objective: A British god of the wild linked by the Romans to Silvanus.
key_results: Callirius had a temple near Colchester.
The Romans equated him with Silvanus.
He guarded the forest and the land.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2008.
